watch.summary: A streamer playing an egg physics game celebrates prematurely by jumping out of his chair, only to frantically scramble back when the egg keeps rolling unpredictably.

beats.what: The streamer counts his egg's bounces as he attempts a difficult jump.
The egg hits a huge bounce up into a higher level.
He yells in victory and jumps out of his chair to celebrate.
He notices the egg is still rolling dangerously close to the edge.
He hurries back to his chair, pleading with the egg in complete disbelief.

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The energetic premature victory celebration followed immediately by sheer panic as the physics keep going creates high-energy slapstick comedy. His physical jump out of the frame and awkward scramble back into his seat heightens the humor.
